gloss: lowest score; lowest point; minimum mark

definitions.gloss: lowest score; worst mark; minimum points
definitions.explanation: The worst or lowest score achieved in a test, competition, or evaluation.
The figuratively or physically lowest point of something, such as the low point of a career, economy, or terrain.

examples.japanese: {最低点|さいていてん}は30{点|てん}だった。
{合格|ごうかく}{最低点|さいていてん}に{届|とど}かなかった。
examples.english: I didn't reach the minimum passing score.

examples.japanese: {今学期|こんがっき}の{数学|すうがく}の{最低点|さいていてん}を{取|と}ってしまい、{落|お}ち{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I got the lowest math score this semester and felt down.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}は{最低点|さいていてん}を{打|う}った。
{支持率|しじりつ}が{最低点|さいていてん}を{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: The approval rating reached a new low.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{最低点|さいていてん}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がった{経験|けいけん}が、{今|いま}の{自分|じぶん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: The experience of climbing back up from the lowest point in my life made me who I am today.

notes:
Composed of {最低|さいてい} (lowest; worst) and {点|てん} (point; score). In academic contexts, {合格|ごうかく}{最低点|さいていてん} (minimum passing score) is an especially important compound, as Japanese entrance exams often publish this figure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格|ごうかく}{最低点|さいていてん}: minimum passing score
- {最低点|さいていてん}を{取|と}る: to get the lowest score
- {最低点|さいていてん}を{打|う}つ: to hit the lowest point
- {最低点|さいていてん}を{更新|こうしん}する: to reach a new low

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最高点|さいこうてん}: highest score/point — the opposite
- {底値|そこね}: rock-bottom price — specifically about prices
- {最低|さいてい}: lowest; worst — the broader adjective/noun
